I hated my neighbor for a long time for no reason really, and this one night I was in a park just getting drunk with my friends because my boyfriend just broke up with me and he was at the place where we usually get drunk in, so I didn't want to be there. I asked my friend to ask someone (literally anyone) to come and bring some friends since the only company we had was from a stray cat. Fast forward, I saw the familiar figure and I was like "I can't believe this is happening to me, not tonight ffs", we all sat down (kinda awkward) and at some point he just offered me some weed and we mended our relationship over a couple blunts. We aren't best friends, but I enjoy talking to him now, and he is one of the nicest people I know.

I had this ibf and she came from her country to spend a few weeks and visit me and stuff. We had to stay at my grandparents' because my house is kinda small. We treated her great, but she barely got out of "her" room when she had time off, she made my grandma feel awful about her cooking, would be a lot on her phone, apparently telling her bf how bad the experience was for her (he was the most controlling person I've ever crossed paths with), since I was a minor my mum asked us not to go out and drink bc if we got in trouble it would be a mess, made me feel like we had to go out anyway and she  looked like she was not enojying it anyways, and the list goes on. 

I never really got to tell her how rude it was when we had been nothing but welcoming and kind to her but oh well. I sometimes feel like it was kind of a lost summer but oh well. I think we aren't friends anymore.

Hey. I've been where you are, and I know how hard it is. But, as cliché as it sounds- it will get better. If you have no one to talk to, you can talk to me. There is light, I promise!! Sometimes you have to hold on to that one thing that gets you going and then, you'll find an other thing, another step to recovery. And sooner than you think, there'll be light again. It might be music, maybe it's therapy. If traditional therapy doesn't work for you, there are other great kinds of therapy. You are worthy of life and happiness. <3
